description: On a rainy city street at dusk, in front of a bakery window full of bread, a laughing young man in a white T-shirt, soaked with rain, holds his black jacket up over his head and over a smiling young woman in a camel coat to keep her dry. She holds a paper bakery bag and touches her wet hair, and the two walk along the shop front together under the striped awning, laughing. Behind them a red telephone box, people with umbrellas, a parked bicycle and street lamps line the wet pavement.
